title: Faculty Posts (Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor)
qualification: MBBS or equivalent as per IMC Act 1956, MD/MS/DM/MCh or equivalent as per speciality, Teaching/research experience as specified per post, Registration with Central/State Medical Council
salary: Level-13-A1 (Entry level pay Rs.131400/-) Plus NPA
age_limit: All Posts: As per Govt. of India rules for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/Ex-SM.
selection_process: Screening of applications || Interview || Document Verification

title: Junior Research Fellow and Multi-Tasking Staff
qualification: M.E./M.Tech. in BME/IT/CSE/ECE or MCA or M.Sc. in Computer Science/Electronics with CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or selected through National level examinations, OR Graduate/Diploma in any stream.
salary: Junior Research Fellow (JRF):₹37,000/- per month + HRA (as per funding agency norms) || Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS):₹18,000/- per month
age_limit: Please refer to the official notification for age limit details.
application_fee: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.
selection_process: Selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. (for JRF) || Selection committee decision will be final.
